chapter.heading: BOOK ONEPsalm 1The Righteous and the Wicked Contrasted.
chapter.v:
Blessed [fortunate,
prosperous, and favored by God] is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked [following their advice and example], Nor stand in the path of sinners, Nor sit [down to rest] in the seat of scoffers (ridiculers).

But his
delight is in the law of the Lord, And on His law [His precepts and teachings] he [habitually] meditates day and night. [Rom 13:8-10; Gal 3:1-29; 2 Tim 3:16]

And he
will be like a tree firmly planted [and fed] by streams of water, Which yields its fruit in its season; Its leaf does not wither; And in whatever he does, he prospers [and comes to maturity]. [Jer 17:7, 8]

¶The wicked
[those who live in disobedience to God’s law] are not so, But they are like the chaff [worthless and without substance] which the wind blows away.

Therefore the
wicked will not stand [unpunished] in the judgment, Nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

For the
Lord knows and fully approves the way of the righteous, But the way of the wicked shall perish.
